_help: Job (class select) geometry in 1366x768 space. The big class illustration is not here: each class carries its own WZ origin and is drawn at (-artX,-artY). list is the narrow card panel (313x593, 2 columns x 7 rows, grid pitch is fixed in code); listGlass is the dark backing alpha 0-255 and listPad how far it hangs past the art (the WZ grid sits flush with its edges, so that overhang is the only padding); pageGap is the gap between the list backing and the pager bar; name/mark/sub/desc are the WZ desc positions (name is the big class name art); descLine is the description line advance; cardPad is the info card padding past the text; stat is the first stats row, statValueX the value column, statLine the row advance; make/back are art-sized buttons (art sets the size); errorY is centered text. Keys may be omitted (keeps current value). DEBUG builds reload this file live on save.
